title: Getting Started with Web Development
author: Khairunnisa
description: Learn the basics of building websites using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
content: Web development is the process of creating websites. HTML provides structure, CSS adds design, and JavaScript makes websites interactive.

title: Why React is Popular
author: Alex Morgan
description: Discover how React helps developers build interactive user interfaces.
content: React is a JavaScript library used to build user interfaces. It helps developers create reusable components and modern web applications.

title: Learning Python as a Beginner
author: Sarah Lee
description: A simple guide to starting your programming journey with Python.
content: Python is a beginner-friendly programming language. It is used in web development, automation, artificial intelligence and data science.

title: Understanding Artificial Intelligence
author: John David
description: Explore how artificial intelligence is changing our daily lives.
content: Artificial Intelligence allows computers to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. Examples include voice assistants and image recognition.

title: Tips for Writing Better Code
author: Emily Rose
description: Simple practices that make your code easier to read and maintain.
content: Good code should be clear and organised. Use meaningful variable names, keep functions small and test your work regularly.

title: The Future of Technology
author: Michael Smith
description: Explore exciting technologies shaping the future.
content: Artificial intelligence, cloud computing, robotics and cybersecurity are important areas shaping the future of technology.
